verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a marketing claim that Zero Trust controls are built into the network and run on every request. That implies access gating for apps on Workers, but nothing in the pack documents connecting an organization's identity provider (SSO/SAML/OIDC) to protect internal apps, deployments, or agents. The OAuth on the Cloudflare MCP server and the scoped API tokens are Cloudflare-account auth, not org-IdP integration, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documented IdP/SSO integration (e.g., Access with Okta/Entra/OIDC), how Workers apps and preview deployments are gated behind it, identity-based auth for agents, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
